dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
桜並木の一角から、黄色と青の耳が飛び出して
いた。
dialogues.en:
Sticking out of the cherry blossom trees, I see some yellow
and blue ears.
dialogues.text:
Sticking out of the cherry blossom trees, I see some yellow
and blue ears.

dialogues.jp:
風に揺られているのか、自分で揺れているのか
ひょこひょことウサギのようだ。
dialogues.en:
They look like a bunny rabbit's ears, swaying in the wind or
swinging by themselves.
dialogues.text:
They look like a bunny rabbit's ears, swaying in the wind or
swinging by themselves.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、さくら」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Sakura."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゅ？　あっ、お兄ちゃん今お帰り？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Oh, are you going home now?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Oh, are you going home now?"

dialogues.jp: ぴょん、といつもの笑顔が飛び出してくる。
dialogues.en: I see a familiar smile on her face.
dialogues.text: I see a familiar smile on her face.

dialogues.jp: 「お前は何やってるんだこんな所で？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「桜の下でひなたぼっこだよ♪　ポッカポ
　カ〜♪」
dialogues.en:
"I've been basking in the sun under the cherry blossoms.
It's nice and warm~."
dialogues.text:
"I've been basking in the sun under the cherry blossoms.
It's nice and warm~."

dialogues.jp: 満面の笑顔で、ぎゅ〜、っと抱きついてくる。
dialogues.en: She flings her arms around me with a dazzling smile.
dialogues.text: She flings her arms around me with a dazzling smile.

dialogues.jp:
「うわっ、あったかいけど離れろ！　人が見て
　るっての！」
dialogues.en:
"Whoa, you're warm, but keep your hands off of me! People
are looking at us!"
dialogues.text:
"Whoa, you're warm, but keep your hands off of me! People
are looking at us!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃはは。湯たんぽ湯たんぽ」
dialogues.en: "Wahaha. I'm a hot-water bottle."
dialogues.text: "Wahaha. I'm a hot-water bottle."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それを言うならカイロだ！」
dialogues.en: "More like a pocket heater!"
dialogues.text: "More like a pocket heater!"

dialogues.jp: うぎ〜、と少々力任せに引き｛は／剥｝がす。
dialogues.en: Oohh... I try pushing her away by force.
dialogues.text: Oohh... I try pushing her away by force.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Owwww...!"
dialogues.text: "Owwww...!"

dialogues.jp:
さくらも必至に粘ろうとするが、リーチの差で
手が届かない距離まで押しやる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura tries to hang on, but I push her body away from me
with my long reach.
dialogues.text:
Sakura tries to hang on, but I push her body away from me
with my long reach.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ちぇっ！　減るもんじゃないのにケチ」
dialogues.en: "Damn it! You're not gonna lose anything, you cheapskate."
dialogues.text: "Damn it! You're not gonna lose anything, you cheapskate."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……見事なまでに減るんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I will lose a lot."
dialogues.text: "I will lose a lot."

dialogues.jp:
女の子にこんな感じに抱きつかれる回数なんて
一生のうちにそうないはずだからな。
dialogues.en:
I know there aren't going to be many opportunities in my
life that girls hug me like this.
dialogues.text:
I know there aren't going to be many opportunities in my
life that girls hug me like this.

dialogues.jp:
貴重な回数を、凹凸のない感触で消費してしまっ
た。
dialogues.en: I wasted the limited opportunities for uncurved touch.
dialogues.text: I wasted the limited opportunities for uncurved touch.

dialogues.jp: 「しかし、テスト前日だってのに余裕だな」
dialogues.en:
"How can you afford to be like this when you have an exam
tomorrow?"
dialogues.text:
"How can you afford to be like this when you have an exam
tomorrow?"

dialogues.jp:
それほど重要なテストってわけじゃないが、春
休みの補習が絡んでくるかも知れないので手は
抜けない。
dialogues.en:
I know it's not really an important exam, but you can't get
lazy about studying because I might have to take a remedial
class during the spring break.
dialogues.text:
I know it's not really an important exam, but you can't get
lazy about studying because I might have to take a remedial
class during the spring break.

dialogues.jp: 「勉強しなくても平気なのか？」
dialogues.en: "Aren't you going to study?"
dialogues.text: "Aren't you going to study?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうだね。ウチに帰ったら漢字の勉強しな
　きゃ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I have to study Chinese characters when I go home."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I have to study Chinese characters when I go home."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「漢字？　３組はテストの内容が違うのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Chinese characters? Does your class have a different exam
from ours?"
dialogues.text:
"Chinese characters? Does your class have a different exam
from ours?"

dialogues.jp: 現国も古文も明後日だった気がするが。
dialogues.en:
I thought the exam for Language and Classic Literature will
be the day after tomorrow.
dialogues.text:
I thought the exam for Language and Classic Literature will
be the day after tomorrow.

dialogues.jp: てへへへへ、と苦笑いを浮かべられる。
dialogues.en: She gives me a bitter grin.
dialogues.text: She gives me a bitter grin.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「同じだよ。ボクはテストの回答よりも、問題
　を読むほうが難しいから……特に歴史とか政
　治」
dialogues.en:
"Actually, it's the same, but I have a hard time reading the
questions rather than answering them, especially History and
Government."
dialogues.text:
"Actually, it's the same, but I have a hard time reading the
questions rather than answering them, especially History and
Government."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「へぇ。そりゃ難儀だな」
dialogues.en: "Whoa, what a bummer."
dialogues.text: "Whoa, what a bummer."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ナンギって堅気の仲間？　そういうのが分か
　らない」
dialogues.en:
"Does 'bummer' mean the same as 'wise'? See, I don't
understand things like that."
dialogues.text:
"Does 'bummer' mean the same as 'wise'? See, I don't
understand things like that."

dialogues.jp:
首を傾けるのと一緒に、頭のリボンが左右に揺
れる。
dialogues.en:
She cocks her head, making the bow on her head sway left and
right.
dialogues.text:
She cocks her head, making the bow on her head sway left and
right.

dialogues.jp: 「大変だ――ってことだ」
dialogues.en: "It means trouble."
dialogues.text: "It means trouble."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「てぇへんだ、か。帰ったら調べなきゃ」
dialogues.en: "Trouble... I'd better look up the word when I get home."
dialogues.text: "Trouble... I'd better look up the word when I get home."

dialogues.jp:
ぶつぶつ、とこめかみに指を当ててさくらが呟
く。
dialogues.en: Sakura mumbles, putting her finger to her temple.
dialogues.text: Sakura mumbles, putting her finger to her temple.

dialogues.jp:
と、なんとなく、そんな仕草を見ているうちに
嫌な考えに｛たど／辿｝り着いた。
dialogues.en: As I watch her gesture, a weird thought occurs to me.
dialogues.text: As I watch her gesture, a weird thought occurs to me.

dialogues.jp: 「……なぁ、お前、もしかして頭いいか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you think you're smart?"
dialogues.text: "Do you think you're smart?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「え、うん、いいよ♪」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I think I am."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I think I am."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「満面の笑みで即答しやがったな……それじゃ
　あ、編入試験のテストとかどうだった？」
dialogues.en:
"An immediate answer with a smile, huh. Then, how did you do
in the examination for admission?"
dialogues.text:
"An immediate answer with a smile, huh. Then, how did you do
in the examination for admission?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん……確か１６０くらいかな？」
dialogues.en: "Well... I think I got about 160."
dialogues.text: "Well... I think I got about 160."

dialogues.jp:
５教科×５０点だから満点で２５０。問題が読
めないことを考えれば、かなり良いことになる。
dialogues.en:
Five subjects times fifty points means the perfect score is
two hundred and fifty points. That's quite good even if she
can't read the questions.
dialogues.text:
Five subjects times fifty points means the perfect score is
two hundred and fifty points. That's quite good even if she
can't read the questions.

dialogues.jp: 「凄いんだな、見かけと違って」
dialogues.en: "Whoa, you're smarter than you look."
dialogues.text: "Whoa, you're smarter than you look."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「凄いんだよ〜、見かけと違って……｛うやま／敬｝え！」
dialogues.en: "I'm much smarter than you think. Give me some respect!"
dialogues.text: "I'm much smarter than you think. Give me some respect!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Sure..."
dialogues.text: "Sure..."

dialogues.jp:
学力と外見と内面の成長が、まったく比例して
いない見本のようだ。
dialogues.en:
This is the perfect example of the difference between how
academic someone might look and their actual skill.
dialogues.text:
This is the perfect example of the difference between how
academic someone might look and their actual skill.

dialogues.jp: 「まぁいいや。それなら勉強一緒にやるか？」
dialogues.en: "Well anyway, do you want to study together?"
dialogues.text: "Well anyway, do you want to study together?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、漢字はひとりでも出来るんだけど
　な〜。ん〜、どうしよっかどうしよっか……
　考え中」
dialogues.en:
"Well, actually I can study Chinese characters by myself.
Let's see...... I'm still thinking..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, actually I can study Chinese characters by myself.
Let's see...... I'm still thinking..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「回りくどいぞ。条件次第だってデコに書いて
　ある」
dialogues.en:
"Stop beating around the bush. I can see that you've got
some kind of condition in mind."
dialogues.text:
"Stop beating around the bush. I can see that you've got
some kind of condition in mind."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「えへへへ。ボクと手を繋いで帰ってくれる
　ならいいよ？」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha. If we go home hand in hand, I will."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha. If we go home hand in hand, I will."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Wha?"
dialogues.text: "Wha?"

dialogues.jp:
世にも恐ろしい条件に、思わずのけぞってしま
う。
dialogues.en: I almost recoil when I hear the awful condition she give.
dialogues.text: I almost recoil when I hear the awful condition she give.

dialogues.jp:
「お前、それが傍から何に見えるか分かってる
　のか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, do you understand what that means to other people?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, do you understand what that means to other people?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ラヴリーな恋人？」
dialogues.en: "They'd see us as a lovely couple, don't you think?"
dialogues.text: "They'd see us as a lovely couple, don't you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「兄妹か誘拐だ」
dialogues.en: "Brother and sister, or a kidnapping."
dialogues.text: "Brother and sister, or a kidnapping."

dialogues.jp:
もう一段階上の領域があるが、そこは踏み入っ
てしまうと抜け出せそうになくて怖い。
dialogues.en:
I don't wanna talk about the next level because I know it'll
take a while if I do.
dialogues.text:
I don't wanna talk about the next level because I know it'll
take a while if I do.

dialogues.jp: まあ、教えてもらうのはいいんだが……。
dialogues.en: I don't mind whether she teaches me, but...
dialogues.text: I don't mind whether she teaches me, but...

dialogues.jp: ◆テスト勉強の取引◆
dialogues.en: ◆A deal on study for the test◆
dialogues.text: ◆A deal on study for the test◆

dialogues.jp:
帰り道にさくらと出会う。なんとなく、学力が
高いと聞いていたさくらに、今度のテストの勉
強を手伝ってもらおうとしたのだが……。
dialogues.en:
I met Sakura on the way home. I thought about asking her to
help me study for tomorrow's exam, since I heard she gets
good grades, but...
dialogues.text:
I met Sakura on the way home. I thought about asking her to
help me study for tomorrow's exam, since I heard she gets
good grades, but...

dialogues.jp:
その条件は、俺と手をつないで帰ることだと言
われてしまう。
dialogues.en: She said she'd only help if we go home holding hands.
dialogues.text: She said she'd only help if we go home holding hands.

choices.en: ○I've got to do what's best for me.
choices.text: ○I've got to do what's best for me.
